description: Make a finished video ad — multi-shot, with a speaking creator, product shots, captions and an optional music bed — from a brief or a storyboard plus an avatar image and a product image. Requires a quote_id from estimate_ad_cost for exactly these fields; returns a job_id to poll with get_ad_job. Credits are charged only when the ad succeeds, and never more than the quote. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

avatar_description.description: Optional one-line identity note for the creator (20-500 characters).

avatar_url.description: Public https URL of the creator's reference image (a catalogue portrait, a generate_avatar result, or an import_asset URL).

brief.description: The ad brief: brandName, brandOneLiner, valueProps (1-8 strings), cta, intent, format (an id from list_ad_formats), shotCount (1-5), totalDurationSec (5-20), aspect (9:16 | 16:9 | 1:1), language, quality (fast | premium), modelTier (standard | cinematic), garmentImageUrl for the try-on formats.

canvas_id.description: Optional board id (from list_canvases or create_canvas): the ad is placed on it as a generation card that fills in when the render lands.

model_tier.description: cinematic renders on Seedance with director-grade camera work and costs more per shot; needs the brief.

needs_avatar_gen.description: True when the avatar still has to be generated (billed as a line).

needs_product_gen.description: True when the product still has to be generated (billed as a line).

persona_mode.description: synthetic lets the studio substitute one consistent generated creator for the avatar; exact-avatar (default) keeps the avatar as given.

product_image_url.description: Public https URL of the product image.

project_id.description: Optional studio project (uuid) to file the run under.

quality.description: Lip-sync tier. premium costs more per talking shot. Defaults to the brief's quality, else fast.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from estimate_ad_cost for these exact fields (kind ad). Required.

storyboard.description: The storyboard returned by write_ad_storyboard, as is or edited. When present it is what renders; the brief is optional alongside it.

name: generate_ad

credits_quoted.description: The ceiling fixed by the quote.

replayed.description: True when this quote_id had already been submitted and the original job was returned.

studio_url.description: The job's page in the studio on AI Content Drop.
